content.thinking: This looks like a duplicate ticket—since it's a constant drip rather than flooding, I don't need to escalate urgency, so I'll just add a note on the existing ticket about it worsening and reply to the tenant, keeping to routine handling rather than requesting an earlier visit.

arguments.note: Tenant emailed 2026-10-10: kitchen tap worsening, now drips constantly even when fully closed. Duplicate of this job, no new ticket. Visit 2026-10-15 08:00-12:00 stands. Contractor to be told of the worsening.

arguments.body: Hi Amelia, thanks for letting us know. Your tap is already booked in under job R-4801: Swift Plumbing & Heating are due on Thursday 15 October, 8am-12pm. I've added a note that it is getting worse so the plumber knows. In the meantime, you can turn off the isolating valve under the sink if the drip gets bad, and put a bowl under it. If it turns into a proper leak or water gets near electrics, please tell us straight away. We'll be in touch after the visit.
